levels.title: Hello app
levels.goal: Wire a complete minimal Shiny app in R.
levels.body:
Every Shiny app is `shinyApp(ui, server)`.
UI is a layout. Server is a function of (input, output, session).
Keep the ids stable — they are the graph endpoints.
levels.hint: Need shinyApp(, textInput, textOutput, renderText, and a server function.

levels.title: Slider drives text
levels.goal: Read a slider and print a formatted result.
levels.body:
Inputs are reactive values: `input$x`.
Outputs are `render*` assigned to `output$...`.
levels.hint: sliderInput("x", ...) and renderText that uses input$x.

levels.title: Share work with a reactive
levels.goal: Put the math in `reactive()` and use it from two outputs.
levels.body:
`reactive({ ... })` caches until inputs change.
Both outputs read the same node — no duplicated formula.
levels.hint: y <- reactive({ input$x * 2 }), then y() in both renders.

levels.title: Commit on button press
levels.goal: Use eventReactive so text updates only when the button is pressed.
levels.body:
Sliders fire on every move. Actions should wait for a click.
`eventReactive(input$go, ...)` freezes the dependency edge until the event fires.

levels.title: Guard with req
levels.goal: Stop output errors when the text input is empty.
levels.body:
`req(...)` raises a silent cancel when its arguments are falsy.
Use it at the top of an output instead of nested if-statements.
